landing.heroSubtitle: The adaptive flashcard platform that turns studying into a habit. Master any subject with precise sessions, addictive gamification, and a global community.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to master what you study
landing.featuresSubtitle: Features built to speed up your progress and keep motivation high.
landing.feat1Body: Adaptive algorithm that surfaces each card at the exact moment you're about to forget it.
landing.feat2Body: Thousands of ready-made decks shared by learners worldwide. Start studying in seconds.
landing.feat3Body: Climb the leaderboard, unlock badges, keep your streak. Studying has never been this addictive.
landing.feat4Body: Study in short, productive blocks. Every minute turns into measurable progress.
landing.feat5Body: Your progress is yours. Private decks, safe data, no invasive tracking.
landing.feat6Body: Study on desktop, tablet, or phone. Everything synced in real time.
landing.howTitle: From curiosity to mastery in 3 steps
landing.howSubtitle: A simple flow designed for consistent results from day one.
landing.step1Body: Build your own decks or pick from thousands shared by the community.
landing.step2Body: The algorithm decides what to review and when. You just show up daily.
landing.step3Body: Track metrics, achievements, and ranking. Knowledge becomes visible reward.
landing.testimonialsSubtitle: Real results from people who transformed the way they learn.
landing.testimonial1: I passed the exam after 4 months of daily Flash Learn. The algorithm actually makes a difference.
landing.testimonial2: I'm in med school and reviewing with adaptive flashcards tripled my pharmacology retention.
landing.testimonial3: I learned 800 Japanese words in 90 days. Gamification kept me from skipping a single day.
landing.finalCtaSubtitle: Join thousands of learners who already turned knowledge into a daily habit.
